tasks.label: Run server (LAN + demo page)
tasks.detail: Serves on any hostname (LAN) and enables the demo page. Use this for testing on other devices.

tasks.label: Run server (hybrid ML + demo page)
tasks.detail: Like the LAN task, but the detector is hybrid: projection first, the ONNX model in models/best.onnx when projection looks unreliable. The raw JSON in the demo page shows which one answered ("method").

tasks.label: Evaluate detectors
tasks.detail: Scores every detector on tests/fixtures, samples/ and the synthetic pages.

tasks.label: Evaluate detectors (with ML model)
tasks.command: uv run --extra ml python -m app.evaluation --corpus tests/fixtures --corpus samples --ml-model models/best.onnx --verbose
tasks.detail: Scores projection, classical, ml and hybrid on tests/fixtures and your local samples/. Needs models/best.onnx.

tasks.label: Lint
tasks.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .

tasks.label: Build Docker image (branch + date)
tasks.detail: Tags the image comic-revolution-panels:<current branch>-<YYYYMMDD>, with characters Docker tags do not allow (such as /) turned into -. For example feature/abc becomes comic-revolution-panels:feature-abc-20261119.
